source: x0x calibration with a hand-derived Env Mod law (listening test)
reference_set: SET-E3 / D3 / C3 resonant-peak sweep tracks (tools/sweep_track.py)
notes: x0x.json with the Env Mod law read off the E3/D3 sweep tracks instead of fitted: depth 0.69 + 4.37 * EnvMod^2 octaves at both Cutoff ends (envModTaperExp 2), bias offset 0.35 (the settled cutoff drops 0.35 x the depth increase), cutoff trim 240 Hz, accent sweep depth 5 oct. On all 400 notes: sweep error 6.39 -> 5.63 semitones (E3 5.3 -> 3.7), weighted error 3.43 -> 3.65 because the rest of x0x was fitted around the old law. Candidate for the sweep-scored optimizer run, not a final calibration.
